verdict.rationale: Yapily is API-first: its Payments, Data, Authorisation and Webhook APIs cover the flows its hosted UI offers, and the docs say the direct API supports payment types the hosted UI does not yet support. However, the docs never state UI/API parity, and nothing shows that console or dashboard functions are available via the API. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, evidence that console and admin settings can be managed via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
